main_claim: With Topuria's next step open between a Gaethje rematch and Pimblett, Pimblett says he would love to fight him but nobody has spoken to him about it.
note: Pimblett's «Me encantaría destrozarle la cabeza... Nadie me ha hablado de eso» is a wish with talks denied, and the 'corrillos' rumour has no who, date or event, so no_fact; a reader could call it a denied rumour (next_fight). The writer himself weighs Topuria's two options and timing, so he shares the piece with Pimblett (one_of_several), though much of the text is about Topuria and main_subject is arguable.

main_claim: Donchenko beat Punahele Soriano by unanimous decision at UFC Paris for his fourth straight UFC win.
note: A fight report: 'здолав Соріано одноголосним рішенням суддів — 30-27, 30-27, 29-28', two knockdowns. The text says he announced it on Instagram but quotes nothing from it (so speaks_of_himself is possible but weaker); «хороші друзі» is two words recalled from an earlier fight, so he_speaks is no.

main_claim: After the official weigh-in for his Soriano fight, Donchenko says he made weight, is fine, and plans to be about 86 kg by the evening.
note: Built on the weigh-in ('Обидва бійці показали вагу 77,11 кг') and his own quotes about it ('Зробили вагу, офіційно зважились... 86 буду важити'). The fact is the weigh-in routine; an editor could instead read it as an interview whose content is no_fact or status_update.

main_claim: Donchenko says Makhachev's record-tying win streak is less spectacular than Anderson Silva's and that Amosov could test the champion.
note: He talks only about other fighters (Makhachev, Garry, Silva, Amosov) and nothing comes back to him; 'fresh off his win over Punahele Soriano' is background. Act is none_of_these because nobody does anything regarding him: he is commenting on others, not speaking of himself; his quotes are in the text, so he_speaks is yes.

main_claim: Pimblett says he would love to fight Topuria but nobody has spoken to him about it, and lists other names for a December return.
note: Pimblett's own news: 'I'd love to smash his head in, lad... No one's spoke to me about it'. Topuria's part is a recap of his June loss, injuries and essay plus 'rumors swirling' with no who, date or event, so nothing new about him (only_mentioned, no_fact); the recap is long enough that one_of_several is arguable.

main_claim: Nathaniel Wood gets unbeaten newcomer Pavel Andrusca as a short-notice replacement opponent at UFC Paris.
note: He appears only as one line in the full card list ('Daniil Donchenko vs. Punahele Soriano'), a booking restated, not news. Act is none_of_these because nobody does or says anything regarding him.
